paper_title: AttentionInfluence Adopting Attention Head Influence for Weak-to-Strong   Pretraining Data Selection
caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
model_annotation: The pie charts compare the clustering results of two different classifiers: AttentionInfluence and FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The AttentionInfluence chart comprises a total of ten slices, with notable segments including "Education" (25%), "Health & Medicine" (22%), and "History & Society" (23%), among others with lower percentages. The colors used for the slices are not distinctly specified but include variations for each segment, and there are several slices visually emphasized, including "Education" which occupies the largest portion of the chart. The FineWeb-Edu Classifier chart features nine slices, with "Education" being the largest category at 38%, followed by "Science & Technology Education" (19%) and "History & Society" (19%). The colors are similarly not specified, and slices are positioned in a way that maintains a clear visual distinction. Each chart includes percentage labels next to the slices, providing clear quantitative data for each category.
